_comment: Layout, sizing and typography for toast. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here. Figma: toast-message — light-toast (14848:2072) + solid-toast (14848:2109).

base._source-icon-circle-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — 28x28 is a fixed frame size on the icon circle, and semantic.spacing has no 28 step
base._source-icon-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — semantic.iconography.sizes are still 'tbd' in design.md; Figma binds the icons-size component at Size=20
base._source-close-icon-size: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — same icons-size Size=20 binding as icon-size

_source.gap / close-gap: Figma nests two rows with different gaps: `Frame 2` puts 16 between the icon and the text block, and `Frame 3` puts 8 between that whole block and the close button. The library was applying 16 to both.

_verified_from.scope: all 7 variants, plus a depth-4 walk of light-toast type=success
_verified_from.result: 358x62, radius 16, padding 8/16, shadow `0,1 blur2 @6%` + `0,1 blur3 @10%` = elevation.card. light-toast strokes 1px INSIDE with the type hue; solid-toast has no stroke. Icon circle 28 with 4 padding and a full radius; icon 20; close 20. Title 16/24 Semibold = title.lg.semibold; caption 14/22 Regular = body.md.regular; the gap between them is 0, which the library already had right.

_corrections.close-gap: The gap between the content and the close button was rendering at 16 because one token was used for both rows. Figma says 8. Added `close-gap` and pointed the outer row at it.

_figma_gaps.warning-type: `solid-toast` has four types — informative, success, warning, error — but `light-toast` has only three: it has no warning. Whether that is intentional needs a designer.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. check-figma-icons.py holds the files in `sources` to exactly this set — an extra icon fails as loudly as a missing one, because an extra is one nobody compared. Files not listed in `sources` carry payload a caller passes, not a choice the design makes.

icons.filled-Warning-2: type=error on light-toast and type=warning on solid-toast
icons.filled-close: the dismiss control, `Frame 3`, on every type
icons.filled-info: type=informative on both sets, inside `Frame 3 > Frame 2 > icon`
